text: ParlayAPI: you were right, it was too fast, and it was a bug in my pacing, not real usage. The engine barely uses ParlayAPI (about 26 credits in the last 3 hours) and your two Starter keys have 10,246 and 16,615 credits left (67% of the plan with 47% of the month to go). One key was first seen by the app yesterday with half its credits already spent, and the pacing rule spread its WHOLE 20,000 over only the days since, so it held back almost everything for a week ('out of usage today'). Fixed: a key met mid-month with a history is paced from the 1st of the month (about 1,100 credits spendable today for that key), a brand-new plan is still spread over the days left; tested. Ships in the next build. On 'stale': the advice blocks now show their age ('as of 4 min ago') and are recomputed after every scan; if a specific line is wrong (e.g. The Odds API after you added keys: it still counts 3,707 credits left over 14 days), tell me which and I'll check its numbers against your keys.
